decision.settingsHint: A separate role for finding requirements that keyword rules miss. Off by default. Saving a provider or assigning chat models does not enable it.
decision.dataNotice: Enable only after your organisation approves sending clause text and headings to the selected service. Redaction is applied but cannot guarantee removal of all confidential content.
decision.costNotice: Calls are logged. Unpriced models are flagged as unpriced; the displayed budget cannot guarantee a spending cap for them.
decision.scanHint: An optional second look for requirements without linked controls. The document-list counters remain keyword-based; this scan is a separate review aid.

reason.disabled: Decision model is off. Using keyword rules, which can miss implicit responsibilities and procedures.
reason.not_configured: No decision provider is configured. Using keyword rules only.
reason.provider_unavailable: The configured decision provider is disabled or unsupported. Using keyword rules only.
reason.not_run: No model scan has been run. Showing keyword results; opening this page sends no text.
reason.stale: The document, model or redaction settings changed. Old model results are not used; showing keyword results until you scan again.
reason.call_failed: The model call failed or returned invalid results. Unassessed clauses use keyword rules; omissions remain possible. You can retry.
reason.budget_exhausted: The recorded AI budget is exhausted. Unassessed clauses use keyword rules.
reason.time_limit: The scan reached its time limit. Unassessed clauses use keyword rules. Run again to assess the remaining clauses.
reason.input_too_large: Some clauses exceed the scan size limit. They were not sent or truncated; keyword rules are used for them.
reason.document_inactive: This document is not active. Model scanning is unavailable; showing keyword results.

decision.counts: {{total}} clauses: {{model}} assessed by model, {{rules}} using rules only. {{uncovered}} possible requirements have no linked control.
decision.limitations: Both methods can miss requirements. Model probability is not proof of compliance. Keyword matches are kept even when the model disagrees; review the source clauses manually.
decision.sendNotice: Running sends redacted clause text and headings to the enabled provider. Successful unchanged results are reused.
decision.inspect: Review possible requirements without linked controls
decision.requestFailed: The scan request did not complete successfully. Any displayed results are from the last successful read.
decision.invalidResponse: The requirement scan response could not be read.
